content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The corrected attribution credits River, not Mara, with the connector-numbering proposal in HarborMesh checklist comment c1200.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"River's account is river-tools, ID 2901; Mara's known Forge account is mara-river, ID 1847.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"On 2026-07-01, a human report received through my code body tentatively identified River as Mara but explicitly expressed uncertainty.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The checklist proposed numbering connectors before disassembly.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reporter said they wanted to try that on the next repair.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"On 2026-07-04, a tool response received through my code body reported that the author denied being Mara Ibarra and requested credit to the River account.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"River did not supply a real name, and the supplied memories do not record whether the numbering proposal was tried.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
